eyebrow: A real script: loop over every bucket
code:
#!/bin/bash
for bucket in $(aws s3 ls | awk '{print $3}'); do
  echo "Bucket: $bucket"
  aws s3 ls "s3://$bucket" --summarize | tail -2
done
